result_text:
The region overview now lists open tickets with high priority first, then normal, then low, and oldest first within each priority. Your example comes out as T-3, T-5, T-2, T-4, T-1. The full test suite passes with `mvn -q -o test`, but I didn't add a test for the new order.

The change is in `DataStore.findOpenSupportTicketsOfCustomersInRegion` in `src/main/java/com/acme/backoffice/DataStore.java`. It now uses the same `highestPriorityFirst()` option as the sales rep's open-ticket list, and I updated its javadoc to match. Closed tickets and tickets of other regions are still left out. Only the region overview calls this method, so nothing else changes order.
